claims: The Charlotte Hornets defeated the Miami Heat 127-126 in overtime.
The Charlotte Hornets vs. Miami Heat game took place on Tuesday, April 14, 2026.
The Charlotte Hornets vs. Miami Heat game was during the NBA Play-In Tournament.
The Charlotte Hornets vs. Miami Heat game took place at Spectrum Center, Charlotte, NC.
The Charlotte Hornets vs. Miami Heat game was an Eastern Conference 9 vs. 10 elimination matchup.
LaMelo Ball secured the win with a last-second layup.
Coby White forced overtime with a 3-pointer.
LaMelo Ball made a game-winning drive.
The Charlotte Hornets vs. Miami Heat game was streamed exclusively on Amazon Prime Video.
The Charlotte Hornets will play the loser of the Orlando Magic vs. Philadelphia 76ers game on Friday, April 17.
The Charlotte Hornets vs. loser of Orlando Magic vs. Philadelphia 76ers game will take place at 6:30 p.m. ET.
The winner of the Charlotte Hornets vs. loser of Orlando Magic vs. Philadelphia 76ers game earns the No. 8 seed in the NBA Playoffs.
